summary: Controls the color and intensity of environmental light in a 3D scene, contributing light from everywhere rather than from a point, spot, or directional source.

key_params.name: material
key_params.note: Render page material for any geometry inside the component

key_params.name: render
key_params.note: Render visibility in conjunction with the render flag

key_params.name: drawpriority
key_params.note: Draw ordering relative to sibling components

key_params.name: pickpriority
key_params.note: Priority for Render Pick CHOP/DAT selection

key_params.name: lightmask
key_params.note: Subset of lights used by geometry when listed in Render TOP

key_concepts: Ambient Light COMP controls scene-wide environmental light color and intensity rather than emitting from a position or spotlight cone.
Light Color and Dimmer shape the global fill contribution, so small changes can affect every lit object in the render.
Ambient lighting has no source position, focus direction, cone, or local falloff; use Light COMP for point, cone, or distant-light behavior.
The Render page and Render TOP lighting setup still determine whether the component contributes to the rendered scene.
Light Mask limits which Render TOP lights affect a geometry object, but the masked lights must also be listed in the Render TOP.
common_gotchas: Ambient Light COMP has no particular source, position, or focus direction.
It provides global environmental illumination rather than shadows, cones, or local falloff.
The light still must be part of the Render TOP lighting setup to affect rendered geometry.
Dimmer and color can wash out contrast quickly because the contribution is scene-wide.
Use Light COMP when a build needs point, spot, or directional behavior instead of ambient fill.
